evals.prompt: Run a read-only test of the complete-task-based-on-hf workflow on https://huggingface.co/models?pipeline_tag=image-text-to-text&sort=trending. Query both trending and downloads, deduplicate model families, resolve canonical release papers, and identify missing evaluations that exactly match existing Papers With Code benchmarks. Do not modify the database. Save a concise audit report.
evals.expected_output: A source-grounded, read-only report that uses live hf CLI rankings, distinguishes official releases from mirrors and finetunes, proves paper ownership, checks exact local benchmark/metric compatibility and existing coverage, and prioritizes safe imports without making database writes.
expectations: The report states that both trending and downloads rankings were queried for image-text-to-text.
The report deduplicates quantizations, mirrors, finetunes, and sibling variants into release families.
Every recommended import names an owning technical report and an exact existing benchmark and metric.
For a high-priority family whose model-card metadata lacks an exact release report, the audit searches Hugging Face Papers by family name before assigning no-report status.
The report distinguishes already-covered, missing-benchmark, missing-metric, non-comparable, and no-report cases.
The database remains unmodified during this read-only test.
